daily.today_energy: Venus is in your sign today, so you're naturally magnetic and your diplomatic gifts are amplified. Mercury in Scorpio might make conversations feel heavier than usual, but you can navigate this with grace.
daily.love: With Venus highlighting your chart, people are drawn to your charm right now. If you're single, someone might make a move. In relationships, your partner feels your effort to connect—lean into genuine conversations despite Mercury's intensity.
daily.career: Mars and Jupiter are firing up ambition and confidence today, though the Sun-Mars square could bring some friction with authority figures. Stay calm, present your ideas clearly, and don't take things personally if feedback feels sharp.
daily.health: The Moon in Taurus wants you to slow down and tend to your body. Skip the hustle mentality today—prioritize rest, good food, and gentle movement. Your nervous system will thank you for the pause.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Libra. With Venus still in your sign and Mars shifting into Virgo mid-week, you're moving from magnetic charm into strategic mode. The Moon's journey through Taurus, Gemini, and Leo fuels shifts in how you operate. Best Day: Wednesday when the Moon trines Mars—momentum flows. Watch-Out Day: Thursday when Sun squares Mars could create friction. Navigate with intention.
weekly.love: Early week, Venus in your sign makes you magnetic—lean into it. Midweek gets spicy when Mars leaves Leo for Virgo; you'll crave deeper conversation over surface-level flirting. The Venus-Jupiter sextile late week amplifies attraction and generosity. Single? Someone notices. Coupled? Real talk leads somewhere good. Wednesday's your strongest day for connection.
weekly.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction early week supercharges ambition, but Sun square Mars mid-week could bring tension with authority or unclear direction. Here's the move: use early-week momentum to pitch ideas, then switch to detailed execution mode when Mars enters Virgo. By weekend, Sun trine Saturn steadies everything. This isn't about speed—it's about smart positioning.
weekly.health: The waxing-to-waning Moon shift signals time to reassess habits. Early week energy is high; channel it into movement. Midweek might feel draining when Mars moves into precision-focused Virgo—your body wants to slow down and reset. Listen to that. By weekend, the Saturn trine brings grounding calm. Rest isn't lazy; it's strategy.
